title: I Move Fast (Annual Instead Of Monthly)
style: fast garage punk, distorted guitar power chords, driving snare, male shouted lead vocal, gang vocal chorus, 156 BPM, builder-confession, fast-hands-anthem, click-first-regret-later
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I move fast and click annual
Instead of monthly — charge my card
Didn't read the screen — didn't read the toggle
Didn't think it would be that hard

One click — one drag — one slip
One whole year on a one-day trip
I was upgrading — I was in the flow
I was building — I was on the go

[Pre-Chorus]
Change it back to monthly — or refund all
And I will resubscribe — that's the call

[Chorus]
I MOVE FAST — I MOVE FAST
ANNUAL INSTEAD OF MONTHLY
I MOVE FAST — I MOVE FAST
IT'S A HABIT NOT A FELONY
I MOVE FAST — I MOVE FAST
CLICK FIRST — REGRET LATER
I MOVE FAST — I MOVE FAST
BUILDER NOT A WAITER

[Verse 2]
The checkout was a single screen
The radio was already filled
I hit the orange button and the year was sold
Before my finger even stilled

This is how the builder works
Fast hands fast feet fast brain
The interface should know the difference
Between a builder and a stain

[Bridge]
I'm not asking for the moon
I'm asking for the month
I'm not asking for a stunt
Just the toggle that I want

[Final Chorus]
I MOVE FAST — I MOVE FAST
ANNUAL INSTEAD OF MONTHLY
I MOVE FAST — I MOVE FAST
IT'S A HABIT NOT A FELONY
FIX THE TOGGLE — FIX THE FLOW
FIX THE THING THE BUILDERS KNOW

[Outro]
Move fast — move fast — move fast — move fast
That's just how the builders move
Move fast — move fast — move fast — move fast
That's just how the builders prove
